## Company Overview / 公司概况

**English:**
- The official website describes 思客琦 (SKEQI) as “行业领先的模组/PACK整线集成商” and “新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线提供商”. **Verified** [1] (company’s own website)
- It says 思客琦 is a high-tech enterprise specializing in intelligent-equipment R&D, production and sales, and provides intelligent-manufacturing overall solutions centered on intelligent equipment. **Verified** [1]
- Main products are listed as 新能源智能装备、其他行业智能装备、工业数字化软件及服务. **Verified** [1]
- It says the company is deeply rooted in new-energy intelligent equipment, with products covering 电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解. **Verified** [1]
- Third-party university job postings state 思客琦 was founded in 2012, has four manufacturing bases in 宁德蕉城、宁德东侨、上海松江、大连北海, has nearly 2,000 employees, and ranked first in 2023 domestic market share for module/PACK production lines. **Verified** [4] (third-party; lower priority than official website)
- An industry publication says the legal entity 宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司 was established in 2016, with registered capital of RMB 100 million, 3 investments, 52 bid participations, 7 trademark records, 240 patent-information items, and 40 administrative licenses. **Verified** [2] (third-party)

**中文：**
- 官网将思客琦描述为“行业领先的模组/PACK整线集成商”和“新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线提供商”。**已验证** [1]（公司自有网站）
- 官网称思客琦是一家专业从事智能装备研发、生产和销售的高新技术企业，为客户提供以智能装备为核心的智能制造整体解决方案。**已验证** [1]
- 主要产品包括新能源智能装备、其他行业智能装备和工业数字化软件及服务。**已验证** [1]
- 官网称公司深度扎根新能源智能装备领域，产品涵盖电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解等电池制造流程。**已验证** [1]
- 第三方高校就业信息显示，思客琦成立于2012年，在宁德蕉城、宁德东侨、上海松江、大连北海设有四大产业制造基地，员工规模近2000人，2023年模组及PACK生产线国内市场占有率排名第一。**已验证** [4]（第三方来源，优先级低于官网）
- 行业媒体报道称，法人主体“宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司”成立于2016年，注册资本10000万人民币，对外投资3家、参与招投标52次、商标信息7条、专利信息240条、行政许可40个。**已验证** [2]（第三方来源）

---

## Core Business / 核心业务

**English:**
- Core positioning: “新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线提供商”, providing new-energy equipment, production lines and solutions. **Verified** [1]
- Battery manufacturing process coverage: 电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解. **Verified** [1]
- Other presented business lines include 琦航数字工厂系统、科派乐智能物流、激光应用技术、工业无损检测、精密智造、汽车与零部件. **Verified** [1]
- The “about” text says main products are 新能源智能装备、其他行业智能装备、工业数字化软件及服务. **Verified** [1]
- No revenue or business-segment financial data are provided in the cited evidence. **Not enough evidence** [1][2][3][4][6]

**中文：**
- 核心定位：“新能源行业领先的模组/PACK整线提供商”，提供新能源设备、产线及解决方案。**已验证** [1]
- 电池制造流程覆盖：电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解。**已验证** [1]
- 官网呈现的其他业务板块包括：琦航数字工厂系统、科派乐智能物流、激光应用技术、工业无损检测、精密智造、汽车与零部件。**已验证** [1]
- “关于我们”称主要产品包括新能源智能装备、其他行业智能装备和工业数字化软件及服务。**已验证** [1]
- 所引用证据中未提供营收或分业务财务数据。**证据不足** [1][2][3][4][6]

---

## Products & Services / 产品与服务

**English:**
- 新能源智能装备: covers 电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解. **Verified** [1]
- 琦航数字工厂系统: self-developed industrial management system; includes PACK线工位、线边库、焊接线、WMS仓储管理、MES生产执行、琦航供应链管理, plus big-data visualization dashboard; based on 5G for digital control and visualization of the full production process. **Verified** [1]
- 科派乐智能物流: intelligent conveying system as core, combined with intelligent transport, warehousing and non-standard automation; serves new energy, automotive manufacturing and 3C electronics; provides independent intelligent transport, smart warehousing and intelligent conveying equipment/services. **Verified** [1]
- 激光应用技术: one-stop laser solutions for new energy, automotive/parts and industrial engineering manufacturing; core technologies are 激光焊接技术、激光能量控制技术、激光整形技术. **Verified** [1]
- 工业无损检测: high-end (2D/3D) X-ray intelligent inspection equipment and solutions; applications include new-energy batteries, electronic/semiconductor welding defects, automotive parts, and aerospace. **Verified** [1]
- 精密智造: precision machining, product processing and mold manufacturing; includes R&D/design/development/production of industrial equipment parts, molds, precision plastics, plastic accessories, hardware accessories, battery parts, and electrical components. **Verified** [1]
- 汽车与零部件: flexible, automated, intelligent production lines for automotive parts and OEMs; products cover body parts, chassis parts and BIW welding equipment lines. **Verified** [1]
- A reported patent: “一种贴胶电芯预堆叠二次定位滑台” (CN224662069U), application date September 2025, designed to keep taped cells from shifting after stacking and improve placement accuracy. **Verified** [2] (third-party)

**中文：**
- 新能源智能装备：涵盖电芯装配、模组成型、PACK封装、电池回收拆解。**已验证** [1]
- 琦航数字工厂系统：自主研发的工业管理系统，配备PACK线工位、线边库、焊接线及WMS仓储管理、MES生产执行、琦航供应链管理等系统，搭配大数据综合可视化看板，依托5G技术实现生产全流程数字化管控与可视化呈现。**已验证** [1]
- 科派乐智能物流：以智能输送系统为核心，结合智能搬运、仓储及非标自动化系统，服务于新能源、汽车制造、3C电子等行业；提供独立的智能搬运、智慧仓储、智能运输设备及服务。**已验证** [1]
- 激光应用技术：面向新能源、汽车及零部件、工业工程制造等领域的一站式激光应用解决方案；聚焦激光焊接技术、激光能量控制技术、激光整形技术。**已验证** [1]
- 工业无损检测：提供高端（2D/3D）X射线智能检测设备及解决方案，应用于新能源电池、电子半导体焊接缺陷、汽车零部件、航空航天等检测场景。**已验证** [1]
- 精密智造：提供精密加工、产品加工和模具制造等业务，包含工业设备零部件、模具、精密塑胶、塑胶配件、五金配件、电池零部件、电器元件的研发、设计、开发、生产。**已验证** [1]
- 汽车与零部件：以汽车零部件及主机厂为主要客户，提供柔性化、自动化、智能化生产线，产品涵盖车身件、底盘件及白车身焊接装备产线。**已验证** [1]
- 报道中的专利：“一种贴胶电芯预堆叠二次定位滑台”（CN224662069U），申请日期2025年9月，能够保证贴胶电芯堆叠后不易偏移、放置精度高。**已验证** [2]（第三方来源）

---

## Industries Served / 服务行业

**English:**
- Intelligent logistics: new energy, automotive manufacturing, 3C electronics. **Verified** [1]
- Laser applications: new energy, automotive and components, industrial engineering manufacturing. **Verified** [1]
- Industrial NDT: new-energy batteries, electronic/semiconductor welding defects, automotive components, aerospace. **Verified** [1]
- Automobiles & components: automotive parts and OEMs. **Verified** [1]
- Third-party job postings additionally describe customers in lithium-battery, new-energy-vehicle, and photovoltaic/energy-storage industries, and say business has expanded to Europe, Southeast Asia and North America. **Verified** [3][4] (third-party; overseas expansion is stated in [4])

**中文：**
- 智能物流：新能源、汽车制造、3C电子等行业。**已验证** [1]
- 激光应用：新能源、汽车及零部件、工业工程制造等领域。**已验证** [1]
- 工业无损检测：新能源电池、电子半导体焊接缺陷、汽车零部件、航空航天等场景。**已验证** [1]
- 汽车与零部件：汽车零部件及主机厂。**已验证** [1]
- 第三方招聘信息还描述客户覆盖锂电池、新能源汽车、光伏/储能行业企业，并称业务已拓展至欧洲、东南亚、北美等海外市场。**已验证** [3][4]（第三方来源；海外拓展信息来自[4]）

## Customer Segments / 客户类型

**English:**
- Official website (first-party): products serve “国际国内主流客户” including 宁德时代、亿纬锂能、中创新航、国轩高科、小鹏、零跑汽车; and 思客琦 provides electrification-transformation support to special-vehicle companies such as 林德、杭叉. **Verified** [1] (first-party)
- Third-party job postings: customer groups mainly include leading lithium-battery companies (宁德时代、中创新航、亿纬锂能、瑞浦能源), well-known new-energy vehicle brands (奥迪、宝马、福特、吉利、上汽、零跑), and PV/energy-storage leaders (晶科能源、海辰). **Verified** [3][4] (third-party)
- Combined, the evidenced customer segments are: battery manufacturers, new-energy vehicle/automobile brands, PV/energy-storage companies, and special-vehicle companies. **Likely / partially supported** [1][3][4]

**中文：**
- 官网（第一方来源）：产品服务于“国际国内主流客户”，包括宁德时代、亿纬锂能、中创新航、国轩高科、小鹏、零跑汽车；同时为林德、杭叉等特种车辆企业提供电动化转型支持。**已验证** [1]（第一方来源）
- 第三方招聘信息：客户群体主要包括宁德时代、中创新航、亿纬锂能、瑞浦能源等头部锂电池企业，奥迪、宝马、福特、吉利、上汽、零跑等知名新能源汽车品牌，以及晶科能源、海辰等光伏或储能头部企业。**已验证** [3][4]（第三方来源）
- 综合来看，证据支持的客户类型包括：锂电池企业、新能源汽车/汽车品牌、光伏/储能企业、特种车辆企业。**可能 / 部分支持** [1][3][4]

## Customers & Partners / 客户与合作伙伴

**English:**
- First-party named customers/partners (official website): 宁德时代、亿纬锂能、中创新航、国轩高科、小鹏、零跑汽车; and 林德、杭叉 as special-vehicle companies receiving electrification support. **Verified** [1] (first-party)

- No independent customer/partner reference pages beyond the homepage/about content are included in the evidence. **Not enough evidence** [1]

## Differentiators / 差异化优势

- Official website claims “行业领先的模组/PACK整线集成商” and “技术成熟度高，成本控制能力强，交付保障能力优.” **Verified** [1] (company claim)
- It highlights “前瞻性布局”: 26万㎡ 宁德二期智造基地逐步投产，以快速响应、高效交付。 **Verified** [1] (company claim)
- It describes an innovation system led by 思客琦智能制造先进技术研究院（IMATI）, focusing on NDT + motion control + “若干” core processes integrated with AI, plus 5G applications, assisted robots and vision applications. **Verified** [1] (company claim)
- Third-party job postings state 2023 module/PACK production-line domestic market share ranked first, and list national/provincial honors and industry awards. **Verified** [4] (third-party; lower priority than official website)

**中文：**
- 官网声称“行业领先的模组/PACK整线集成商”，并称具备“技术成熟度高，成本控制能力强，交付保障能力优”等显著优势。**已验证** [1]（公司自述）
- 官网强调“前瞻性布局”：26万㎡宁德二期智造基地逐步投产，快速响应、高效交付。**已验证** [1]（公司自述）
- 官网称由思客琦智能制造先进技术研究院（IMATI）主导创新体系，聚焦无损检测技术+运动控制技术+智能制造“若干”核心工艺与AI的深度融合，同时涵盖5G应用、辅助机器人及视觉应用等。**已验证** [1]（公司自述）
- 第三方招聘信息称2023年模组及PACK生产线国内市场占有率排名第一，并列出国家级、省级荣誉和行业奖项。**已验证** [4]（第三方来源，优先级低于官网）

## Research Gaps / 信息缺口

**English:**
- The official website does not state a founding year; [4] says “思客琦成立于2012年” while [2] says the legal entity 宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司 was established in 2016. Whether these refer to the same corporate entity is **Not enough evidence** to resolve. [1][2][4]
- No official or independent confirmation of “2023 module/PACK domestic market share first” is present beyond third-party job postings. **Not enough evidence** [3][4]
- No financial/revenue/profit data appear in the cited evidence. **Not enough evidence** [1][2][3][4][6]
- Employee count is “nearly 2,000” per [4] and “1,000–5,000” per [6]; the exact figure is not confirmed by the official website. **Not enough evidence** [4][6]
- The official website “合作伙伴” navigation exists, but the captured evidence contains no partner names or partner-specific details. **Not enough evidence** [1]
- The dates “12月9日” and “11月20日” in [1] are not accompanied by years. **Not enough evidence** [1]
- No specific details on overseas operations are provided beyond the statement of expansion to Europe, Southeast Asia and North America. **Not enough evidence** [4]

**中文：**
- 官网未说明成立年份；[4]称“思客琦成立于2012年”，而[2]称法人主体“宁德思客琦智能装备有限公司”成立于2016年。二者是否指同一法人实体，**证据不足**，无法判定。 [1][2][4]
- “2023年模组及PACK生产线国内市场占有率第一”仅见于第三方招聘信息，无官网或独立来源确认。**证据不足** [3][4]
- 所引证据中没有财务/营收/利润数据。**证据不足** [1][2][3][4][6]
- 员工规模方面，[4]称“近2000人”，[6]称“1000-5000人”，官网未确认具体数字。**证据不足** [4][6]
- 官网有“合作伙伴”导航入口，但所抓取证据中没有合作伙伴名称或具体合作信息。**证据不足** [1]
- [1]中的“12月9日”和“11月20日”未注明年份。**证据不足** [1]
- 除“业务已拓展至欧洲、东南亚、北美”外，证据未提供海外业务的具体细节。**证据不足** [4]
